five 902e8871a917.sql:
WITH b AS (SELECT "path" AS label, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY count(*) DESC, "path") AS n
			FROM views WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10' AND "path" IN ('/p0', '/p1', '/p2', '/p3', '/q0') GROUP BY "path"),
			k AS (SELECT label, n, CASE WHEN n <= 4 OR (SELECT count(*) FROM b) <= 5 THEN label ELSE 'Other' END AS g FROM b)
			SELECT k.g, count(*), count(DISTINCT "actor_id")
			FROM views JOIN k ON "path" = k.label WHERE "project_id" = 1 AND "day" BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-02' AND DATE '2026-09-10'
			GROUP BY k.g ORDER BY MIN(k.n)
